data.label: Conversational Agent
data.name: conversationalAgent
data.description: Conversational agent for a chat model. It will utilize chat specific prompts

inputParams.label: System Message
inputParams.name: systemMessage
inputParams.default:
Assistant is a large language model trained by OpenAI.

Assistant is designed to be able to assist with a wide range of tasks, from answering simple questions to providing in-depth explanations and discussions on a wide range of topics. As a language model, Assistant is able to generate human-like text based on the input it receives, allowing it to engage in natural-sounding conversations and provide responses that are coherent and relevant to the topic at hand.

Assistant is constantly learning and improving, and its capabilities are constantly evolving. It is able to process and understand large amounts of text, and can use this knowledge to provide accurate and informative responses to a wide range of questions. Additionally, Assistant is able to generate its own text based on the input it receives, allowing it to engage in discussions and provide explanations and descriptions on a wide range of topics.

Overall, Assistant is a powerful system that can help with a wide range of tasks and provide valuable insights and information on a wide range of topics. Whether you need help with a specific question or just want to have a conversation about a particular topic, Assistant is here to assist.

data.label: Google Gemini
data.name: chatGoogleGenerativeAI
data.description: Wrapper around Google Gemini large language models that use the Chat endpoint

inputParams.label: Custom Model Name
inputParams.name: customModelName
inputParams.description: Custom model name to use. If provided, it will override the model selected

inputParams.label: Allow Image Uploads
inputParams.name: allowImageUploads
inputParams.description: Allow image input. Refer to the docs for more details.

inputParams.label: Thinking Budget
inputParams.name: thinkingBudget
inputParams.description: Guides the number of thinking tokens. -1 for dynamic, 0 to disable, or positive integer (Gemini 2.5 models).

inputParams.label: Thinking Level
inputParams.name: thinkingLevel
inputParams.description: Adjust the amount of reasoning effort based on the complexity of the user request

inputParams.label: Top Next Highest Probability Tokens
inputParams.name: topK
inputParams.description: Decode using top-k sampling: consider the set of top_k most probable tokens. Must be positive

inputParams.label: Safety Settings
inputParams.name: safetySettings
inputParams.description: Safety settings for the model. Refer to the official guide on how to use Safety Settings

options.label: Dangerous
options.name: HARM_CATEGORY_DANGEROUS_CONTENT
options.description: Promotes, facilitates, or encourages harmful acts.

options.label: Harassment
options.name: HARM_CATEGORY_HARASSMENT
options.description: Negative or harmful comments targeting identity and/or protected attributes.

options.label: Hate Speech
options.name: HARM_CATEGORY_HATE_SPEECH
options.description: Content that is rude, disrespectful, or profane.

options.label: Sexually Explicit
options.name: HARM_CATEGORY_SEXUALLY_EXPLICIT
options.description: Contains references to sexual acts or other lewd content.

options.label: None
options.name: BLOCK_NONE
options.description: Always show regardless of probability of unsafe content

options.label: Only High
options.name: BLOCK_ONLY_HIGH
options.description: Block when high probability of unsafe content

options.label: Medium and Above
options.name: BLOCK_MEDIUM_AND_ABOVE
options.description: Block when medium or high probability of unsafe content

options.label: Low and Above
options.name: BLOCK_LOW_AND_ABOVE
options.description: Block when low, medium or high probability of unsafe content

options.label: Threshold Unspecified (Default Threshold)
options.name: HARM_BLOCK_THRESHOLD_UNSPECIFIED
options.description: Threshold is unspecified, block using default threshold

inputParams.label: Base URL
inputParams.name: baseUrl
inputParams.description: Base URL for the API. Leave empty to use the default.

data.label: Exa Search
data.name: exaSearch
data.description: Wrapper around Exa Search API - search engine fully designed for use by LLMs

inputParams.label: Tool Description
inputParams.name: description
inputParams.description: Description of what the tool does. This is for LLM to determine when to use this tool.
inputParams.default: A wrapper around Exa Search. Input should be an Exa-optimized query. Output is a JSON array of the query results

inputParams.label: Num of Results
inputParams.name: numResults
inputParams.description: Number of search results to return. Default 10. Max 10 for basic plans. Up to thousands for custom plans.

inputParams.label: Use Auto Prompt
inputParams.name: useAutoprompt
inputParams.description: If true, your query will be converted to a Exa query. Default false.

inputParams.label: Category (Beta)
inputParams.name: category
inputParams.description: A data category to focus on, with higher comprehensivity and data cleanliness. Categories right now include company, research paper, news, github, tweet, movie, song, personal site, and pdf

inputParams.label: Include Domains
inputParams.name: includeDomains
inputParams.description: List of domains to include in the search, separated by comma. If specified, results will only come from these domains.

inputParams.label: Exclude Domains
inputParams.name: excludeDomains
inputParams.description: List of domains to exclude in the search, separated by comma. If specified, results will not include any from these domains.

inputParams.label: Start Crawl Date
inputParams.name: startCrawlDate
inputParams.description: Crawl date refers to the date that Exa discovered a link. Results will include links that were crawled after this date. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

inputParams.label: End Crawl Date
inputParams.name: endCrawlDate
inputParams.description: Crawl date refers to the date that Exa discovered a link. Results will include links that were crawled before this date. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

inputParams.label: Start Published Date
inputParams.name: startPublishedDate
inputParams.description: Only links with a published date after this will be returned. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

inputParams.label: End Published Date
inputParams.name: endPublishedDate
inputParams.description: Only links with a published date before this will be returned. Must be specified in ISO 8601 format.

inputs.description: A wrapper around Exa Search. Input should be an Exa-optimized query. Output is a JSON array of the query results

outputAnchors.name: exaSearch
outputAnchors.label: ExaSearch
outputAnchors.description: Wrapper around Exa Search API - search engine fully designed for use by LLMs
